response.content:
The ledger cannot support the premise of your question. Spend did not quadruple from 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-22: it was $967.73 in the first period and $600.95 in the second, a decrease of $366.78 (about 38% lower).

The shift was driven by a drop in `claude-opus-5` spend ($765.29 → $218.18, −$547.11), partly offset by higher `claude-sonnet-5-5` spend ($201.79 → $381.61, +$179.82). The ledger does not record a reason for that model-mix change.
